notes.note: Your foundation is Virgo rising with Gemini Sun, Aquarius Moon and Capricorn Saturn, and every point here repeats its sign, so the chart's core themes are fully carried rather than redirected. Gemini Jupiter sharing the Sun's sign adds a steady, communicative emphasis across the whole map.

Here the Moon, Mercury, Venus and Jupiter all shift into Cancer, with Virgo ascendant moving to Leo, so your resources and feelings take on a more nurturing, family-oriented emphasis. Leo, Cancer and the Sun's Gemini sign together suggest you may draw on warmth and steadiness more than on pure analysis.

Gemini on the ascendant and Sun repeats the foundation, while Leo Moon and Mercury and Capricorn Venus and Ketu bring a more grounded, emotionally structured tone to your daily life. Your Saturn stays in Capricorn, a consistency signal that discipline and responsibility remain a stable thread.

Virgo ascendant and Gemini Sun repeat their D1 signs, so your self and vitality stay consistent, while the Moon moves into Gemini and Mercury into Capricorn. Jupiter in Scorpio and Rahu in Libra add a relational and transformative edge to the theme of children and creativity.

Virgo ascendant and Saturn in Capricorn repeat their D1 signs, a sign that your basic character and discipline carry forward into the marriage and partnership layer. The Sun shifts to Libra and Venus to Scorpio, which points to partnership shaping how you express yourself and your intensity.

Your Sun stays in Gemini while the ascendant moves to Aquarius and Saturn to Virgo, shifting career emphasis toward independent, service-minded work. Jupiter in Capricorn and Moon in Leo suggest that public responsibility and visibility are central to how your professional life unfolds.

Saturn in Capricorn and the Sun in Gemini repeat their D1 signs, so your deeper patterns and parental and ancestral threads stay steady. Moon and Mercury in Virgo bring a practical, detail-oriented lens to how you process the past and your inner life.

The Sun moves to Leo and the Moon to Scorpio, with Venus in Pisces, which suggests your learning and knowledge take on a more intense, spiritual flavour than your foundation. Saturn and Rahu both in Cancer point to emotional roots and inherited patterns as a shared theme for your studies.

Mars in Pisces and Jupiter in Gemini repeat their D1 signs, a faint consistency signal that these energies hold their character under this fine lens. This varga is subtle, so treat its Scorpio ascendant and Taurus Saturn as tentative hints about hidden tendencies rather than firm conclusions.

Your Sun stays in Gemini and Saturn in Capricorn, repeating their D1 signs, a faint sign of continuity in core identity. This is a very fine-grained layer, so treat the Taurus Moon and Aquarius Jupiter as tentative shadings rather than defining features.
